structure: Single high school course. Header u1 gives 'Grade/Course: Geography / ACCN: No ACCN'. Pages are series of small tables: Strand (Geography) + Standard heading: standard number only ('1'..'5') with no title; per benchmark a table with Topic, benchmark text and code (benchmark code SS.12G.n.m in a separate row), Sample Performance (example task), 'Assessment (SPA)' and a 4-level Rubric (Advanced/Proficient/Partially Proficient/Novice in C1-C4). Rubric sentences sometimes split across page breaks.
issues: Rubric rows and 'Assessment (SPA)' labels labeled backup as assessment material; 'Sample Performance' tasks labeled examples.
Course has no stated grade; assigned 9-12.
Standard headings consist only of a bare number (u4, u43, u85, u107, u167); no standard title text in the document.
u222-u229: rubric row split across page break (backup).
